targets.rawSql:
WITH per_eng AS (
  SELECT process_id, eng, engtype,
    max(counter) - min(counter) AS busy_seconds,
    extract(epoch FROM (max(time) - min(time))) AS wall_seconds,
    count(*) AS n
  FROM windows_gpu_engine_time_seconds
  WHERE time > now() - interval '5 minutes'
  GROUP BY process_id, eng, engtype
  HAVING count(*) > 1
), windowed AS (
  SELECT process_id, engtype,
    sum(busy_seconds) AS busy_seconds,
    max(wall_seconds) AS wall_seconds
  FROM per_eng
  GROUP BY process_id, engtype
)
SELECT
  process_id AS "PID",
  engtype AS "Engine",
  round(((busy_seconds / NULLIF(wall_seconds, 0)) * 100)::numeric, 1) AS "Busy %"
FROM windowed
WHERE (busy_seconds / NULLIF(wall_seconds, 0)) > 0.01
ORDER BY "Busy %" DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH dedicated AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (process_id) process_id, gauge AS dedicated_bytes
  FROM windows_gpu_process_memory_dedicated_bytes
  ORDER BY process_id, time DESC
), shared AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (process_id) process_id, gauge AS shared_bytes
  FROM windows_gpu_process_memory_shared_bytes
  ORDER BY process_id, time DESC
), local AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (process_id) process_id, gauge AS local_bytes
  FROM windows_gpu_process_memory_local_bytes
  ORDER BY process_id, time DESC
), non_local AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (process_id) process_id, gauge AS non_local_bytes
  FROM windows_gpu_process_memory_non_local_bytes
  ORDER BY process_id, time DESC
), committed AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (process_id) process_id, gauge AS committed_bytes
  FROM windows_gpu_process_memory_committed_bytes
  ORDER BY process_id, time DESC
)
SELECT
  d.process_id AS "PID",
  d.dedicated_bytes AS "Dedicated",
  s.shared_bytes AS "Shared",
  l.local_bytes AS "Local",
  n.non_local_bytes AS "Non-Local",
  c.committed_bytes AS "Committed"
FROM dedicated d
LEFT JOIN shared s ON s.process_id = d.process_id
LEFT JOIN local l ON l.process_id = d.process_id
LEFT JOIN non_local n ON n.process_id = d.process_id
LEFT JOIN committed c ON c.process_id = d.process_id
ORDER BY d.dedicated_bytes DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH lat AS (
  SELECT time, volume, counter AS lat_c FROM windows_logical_disk_read_write_latency_seconds_total WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND volume IN ($volume)
), rw AS (
  SELECT r.time, r.volume, r.counter + w.counter AS io_c
  FROM windows_logical_disk_reads_total r
  JOIN windows_logical_disk_writes_total w ON r.time = w.time AND r.volume = w.volume
  WHERE $__timeFilter(r.time) AND r.volume IN ($volume)
), joined AS (
  SELECT lat.time, lat.volume, lat_c, io_c FROM lat JOIN rw ON lat.time = rw.time AND lat.volume = rw.volume
), deltas AS (
  SELECT time, volume,
    (lat_c - lag(lat_c) OVER (PARTITION BY volume ORDER BY time)) / NULLIF(io_c - lag(io_c) OVER (PARTITION BY volume ORDER BY time), 0) * 1000 AS ms
  FROM joined
)
SELECT time, volume || ' — combined' AS metric, ms AS value FROM deltas WHERE ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time

    (counter - lag(counter) OVER (PARTITION BY disk ORDER BY time)) / extract(epoch FROM (time - lag(time) OVER (PARTITION BY disk ORDER BY time))) AS rate
  FROM windows_physical_disk_writes_total
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND disk IN ($disk)
)
SELECT time, disk || ' — write' AS metric, rate AS value FROM deltas WHERE rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time

WITH lat AS (
  SELECT time, disk, counter AS lat_c FROM windows_physical_disk_read_write_latency_seconds_total WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND disk IN ($disk)
), rw AS (
  SELECT r.time, r.disk, r.counter + w.counter AS io_c
  FROM windows_physical_disk_reads_total r
  JOIN windows_physical_disk_writes_total w ON r.time = w.time AND r.disk = w.disk
  WHERE $__timeFilter(r.time) AND r.disk IN ($disk)
), joined AS (
  SELECT lat.time, lat.disk, lat_c, io_c FROM lat JOIN rw ON lat.time = rw.time AND lat.disk = rw.disk
), deltas AS (
  SELECT time, disk,
    (lat_c - lag(lat_c) OVER (PARTITION BY disk ORDER BY time)) / NULLIF(io_c - lag(io_c) OVER (PARTITION BY disk ORDER BY time), 0) * 1000 AS ms
  FROM joined
)
SELECT time, disk || ' — combined' AS metric, ms AS value FROM deltas WHERE ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time

)
